name: Lost Love
overview: Scripture reveals that true love is rooted in faith in Christ, who is the only way to the Father and the source of life and truth. Believers are called to trust in Him to overcome troubled hearts, as God's grace and purpose work all things for good to those who love Him. This love is exemplified in the self-sacrificial relationship between Christ and the church, urging believers to clothe themselves with charity, the perfect bond that unites and sustains all relationships.
